items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC1-AC6 met: rel_at per commit (new path exists, even beside a root stub), strict mode, CLI exit 2/3, AC growth across a move, events-layout CI and rollout snapshot read the moved file, --require-baseline in hook and CI; negative control 7/7 fail on origin/main.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: git cannot answer is distinct from not in that commit (GitReadError under strict, CLI exit 3, AC growth warns); empty/dash commits refused; the workflow stops on a failed lookup and warns before an empty base fallback; the PR comment renders the error status.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: no new permissions or secrets in the pull_request workflow; argv lists, no shell; a deleted checker or missing baseline now blocks instead of passing.

items.name: Code Quality
items.note: one lookup in shipwright_layout, thin CLI; files under 300 lines; ruff clean.

items.name: Test Coverage
items.note: test_shipwright_paths_silent_gates.py drives real readers on real git histories and the CLI/anti-ratchet as subprocesses; profile test updated; full F0 suite.
